# Gionee Pakistan Official Store

> The official online store and guide for original Gionee audio products in Pakistan.

This website provides a secure e-commerce platform for purchasing authentic Gionee handsfree devices (3.5mm and Type-C) in Pakistan. It also provides educational guides on identifying original products, comparing models, and understanding pricing.

## Main Sections

- [Store Home](https://gionee.com.pk/): The main homepage for Gionee Pakistan
- [Shop All Products](https://gionee.com.pk/shop): Browse all available Gionee handsfree models
- [Gionee Handsfree 3.5mm](https://gionee.com.pk/gionee-handsfree-3-5mm): Original 3.5mm Jack Handsfree
- [Gionee Handsfree Type-C](https://gionee.com.pk/gionee-handsfree-type-c): Original Type-C Handsfree

## Educational Guides & Comparisons

- [Original vs Fake Guide](https://gionee.com.pk/gionee-handsfree-original-vs-fake): How to spot a fake Gionee handsfree
- [3.5mm vs Type-C Comparison](https://gionee.com.pk/gionee-handsfree-3-5mm-vs-type-c): Which model is right for you?
- [Price in Pakistan](https://gionee.com.pk/gionee-handsfree-price-in-pakistan): Detailed pricing guide for Gionee products
- [Buying Guide](https://gionee.com.pk/gionee-handsfree-buying-guide-pakistan): Comprehensive buying guide for Pakistani consumers
- [Wholesale & Bulk Orders](https://gionee.com.pk/gionee-handsfree-bulk-wholesale): Information for bulk purchases
